notes: Large-source-unit check on אֶל כָּל אֲשֶׁר → *whithersoever*: the single word carries the direction, the universality and the relative, so no morpheme could be split off with a rendering of its own; the grouping is indivisible and is retained, headed on the relative as at JOS.1.7 and JOS.1.9.
The object marker before Joshua is `unrepresented` — the ASV writes the object bare (rule 16) — and the לְ of לֵאמֹר likewise (rule 27).
